item.title: California voters defeat billionaire tax proposal that divided Democrats
item.description: The novel proposal would have charged billionaires a one-time 5% tax on most of their overall wealth, including their ownership in companies.

item.title: France accuses Iran of cyber 'sabotage' in fridge attacks
item.description: France says Iranian military hackers took over refrigeration controllers at around 700 different retail sites last month, turning up temperatures in the middle of the night and spoiling millions of dollars' worth of food.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: British comedian Russell Brand sentenced to over 10 years for rape and sexual assault
item.description: Russell Brand, who became a celebrity darling in the early 2000s, was found guilty on one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault in a case brought by six women.

item.title: Supreme Court weighs effort to shield federal law enforcement as ICE complaints rise
item.description: The Supreme Court considers the case of a prisoner who suffered brutal injuries, only to be denied medical care behind bars. He wants to sue the prison nurse in a case that could change the law on holding federal officers accountable.

item.title: Democrats won big. Can they lower your grocery bill?
item.description: Affordability concerns were top of mind for voters heading into the midterms, as tariffs and the war in Iran drove up prices, including food costs. Now, Americans are expecting relief from Washington.

item.title: Palantir hires a former Democratic senator as it faces scrutiny in new Congress
item.description: The secretive software company has been accused of letting its powerful tools be used by the Trump administration to surveil Americans. Now it's hiring former Sen. Jon Tester to burnish its image.
